## Integer Announces Completion of Acquisition by KKR


November 17, 2026


- [Download PDF (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/600014855/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/17/2026-11-17-PRESS-RELEASE-KKR-Transaction-Completion.pdf)


*~ Positioned to Advance Innovation and Growth in Support of Customers and Patients ~*


PLANO, Texas, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Integer Holdings Corporation (NYSE: ITGR) (“Integer” or the “Company”), a leading global medical device contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), today announced the completion of its acquisition by an affiliate of investment funds managed by KKR, a leading global investment firm, in a transaction valued at an enterprise value of approximately $5.7 billion (the “Transaction”).


The Transaction was announced on August 3, 2026, and was approved by Integer stockholders on October 21, 2026. Under the terms of the Transaction, Integer stockholders will receive $127 per share in cash. With the completion of the Transaction, Integer’s common stock has ceased trading and will no longer be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.


“Today marks an exciting new chapter for Integer, our associates, customers, and the patients we collectively serve,” said Payman Khales, Integer’s President and CEO. “Integer has built a reputation as a trusted partner to the world’s leading medical device companies and emerging innovators through our relentless focus on quality, customer service, and innovation. Together with KKR, we are well positioned to accelerate our growth strategy, further invest in our people, capabilities and technologies, and continue delivering the expertise and solutions that help our customers bring life-enhancing and life-saving devices to patients around the world.”


“We are pleased to officially welcome Integer to the KKR portfolio and look forward to building on the Company’s strong foundation alongside Payman and the management team,” said Max Lin, Partner at KKR. “We see significant opportunities to leverage our resources and expertise to support Integer’s next phase of growth, expand its capabilities and strengthen its position as a trusted partner to the global medical device industry.”


**About Integer** **®**
Integer Holdings Corporation is one of the largest medical device contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) in the world, serving the cardio and vascular, neuromodulation, and cardiac rhythm management markets. As a strategic partner of choice, we advance the goals of our medical device customers through industry-leading engineering and manufacturing, with a relentless commitment to quality, service, and innovation. The Company’s brands include Greatbatch Medical® and Lake Region Medical®. Additional information is available at[www.integer.net](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=wDTiD1txWwsHBUF_NzFj8wlJxf56vHdrPdrpmND6Ub69pv5qrhW6F66TYMyCrKK9x4OnxR6sOPQXs5R-qeLkktb9QiK0hoGADCWAlEoll1I49F18ttwB6Nfa6SsINPCH) .


**About KKR**
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. For additional information about KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE: KKR), please visit KKR’s website at www.kkr.com. For additional information about Global Atlantic Financial Group, please visit Global Atlantic Financial Group’s website at www.globalatlantic.com.
